removed_words: I made this arrangement with intermediate and advanced piano students in mind. The Intro and Postlude (bars 1-25 and 105-end) are mine. The three variations could correspond freely to the three strophes of the lyrics written in 1931 by Eleanor Farjeon to fit the traditional Gaelic tune Bunessan . The song became very popular after British singer Cat Stevens' 1971 version. I encourage the reader and player to find more information about Morning has Broken, easily found on the internet.
